context: Annotated line chart of synthetic stock price crash & recovery over 500 trading days, with event markers, trend line, range arrow, average band, and force-simulated callout labels
first_impression: Structurally honest line chart with data-driven domains and mathematically grounded annotations, appropriate for showing variance on a non-zero baseline.
what_works: Y-domain uses d3.min/max with padding so no hardcoded magic numbers; the -39.3% range arrow and callout prices are computed from actual data values, not manually entered; single Y-axis avoids dual-axis fabrication.
what_doesnt: Date generation has a redundant overwrite (two conflicting date calculations per point at lines 73-77) that could corrupt x-positioning on some indices; line.defined() is absent, which is benign here but would silently draw false continuity if any NaN prices appeared in real data.
